fields.label: Occasion
fields.description: The event or reason the order is for, in a word or two. Never the product itself. Examples: baby shower, Diwali gifting, housewarming.

fields.label: Items
fields.description: A one-line summary of what was ordered, in the message's own words. Fill it as soon as any message says what is ordered, even when the same message also gives size or flavour (repeat them here). Never add a product word that is not in the chat. Examples: a box of 12 brownies, a dozen donuts, 2 sarees.

fields.label: Due date
fields.description: The day the customer needs the order, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Resolve words like "next Tuesday" against the message date.

fields.label: Time
fields.description: The time of day for pickup or delivery, as 24-hour HH:MM. Examples: 11 am is 11:00, 3 pm is 15:00.

fields.label: Fulfilment
fields.description: How the customer gets the order: pickup (they collect it), delivery (the business delivers it) or courier (sent through a courier service).

fields.label: Address
fields.description: Where the order is delivered or couriered. Only needed for delivery or courier. Example: Flat 4B, Lotus Residency, Koramangala.

fields.label: Tracking number
fields.description: The courier's tracking or consignment number, once the order has been shipped.

fields.label: Price agreed
fields.description: The total price the business and customer agreed for the whole order, copied as written. Example: ₹2500.

fields.label: Advance requested
fields.description: The advance amount the business asks the customer to pay, copied as the business wrote it. Fill it only when the business states an amount. Example: ₹1000.

fields.label: Fabric
fields.description: The fabric or material. Examples: Kanjivaram silk, cotton, georgette.

fields.label: Colour
fields.description: The colour or colour combination wanted. Example: peacock blue with a silver border.

fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: How many pieces were ordered. Example: 3.

fields.label: Blouse measurements
fields.description: Blouse measurements the customer gives, copied as written. Example: bust 36, waist 32, length 15.

fields.label: Fall and pico
fields.description: Whether the saree needs fall and pico stitching, with any detail. Example: fall and pico needed.

fields.label: Embroidery
fields.description: The exact name or words to be embroidered, copied letter for letter, including the customer's own spelling. Example: Meenakshi & Suresh.
